newsitem.title: ITALY: Omnitel positive on 1997 after Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Omnitel positive on 1997 after Q1 results.

text.p: Italy's mobile phone consortium Omnitel said on Monday that it was positive on 1997 after "very good" results in the first quarter of the year.
In a statement after a shareholders' meeting Omnitel said: "The very good results for the first three months make us foresee for Omnitel another year of great success."

The shareholders' meeting was to confirm Omnitel's directors for a further three years. Omnitel's chairman is Carlo Peretti, vice-chairman Roberto Colaninno and managing director Silvio Scaglia. The group did not give details of the Q1 results.

Omnitel, 35.5 percent owned by Olivetti, earlier this month said it had 913,000 subscribers for its GSM digital mobile phone service up to the end of the first quarter since its launch in December 1995. This was up 200,000 from the level at the start of this year.
